column1: # Partition coefficients Kd (log10 of L/kg: sorbed mol per kg of solid over dissolved mol per litre) of metals,
# from Allison and Allison (2005), Partition Coefficients for Metals in Surface Water, Soil, and Waste, U.S. EPA
# report EPA/600/R-05/074 (public domain): Table 3 soil/soil water, Table 4 sediment/pore water, Table 5
# suspended matter/water. The value is the median where the report gives one and the mean (marked in "stat")
# where it gives none; min and max are the report's range. Many entries come from regressions, MINTEQA2 or
# judgement rather than measurements (the report's confidence levels); none is specific to one clay mineral.
# oxidation: blank = every oxidation state of the element.
